notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
A new update for Akeno's Veil is available now! 

We appreciate all the feedback from you all, and have made some overall improvements to the game!


What's New

Anomaly Discoveries
We've made some changes to the way anomalies appear - Anomalies previously discovered will no longer repeat until all discoveries are made. 


Lore
We have added in Journal entries! Once you complete a run you will be able to find a journal entry written by Akeno herself. There are 7 total to collect.


New Ending
A new 'true' ending level has been added to the game for those who discover every anomaly!


New Achievement
A new achievement has been added into the game!


Improvements
New tutorial screen has been added to the menus. This provides a clearer explanation of how to play the game.

New Journal screen in the main menu, allowing you to read any discovered journal entries at any time!

Some visual and UI improvements

Bug fixes



Thank you for playing Akeno's Veil!
